purpose: Frozen supplemental multi-claim schema qualification inputs; no live inference
entrypoint: make_llm_batch_assessor -> assess_claims_batch(all four claims, shared evidence pool)
acceptance: Three fresh trials per proposed selected model; every label correct, supporting/partial/contradicting quotes located, all four claims sent together, expected served model and complete physical usage/zero-price caps, no deterministic fallback. Preserve all failures; configuration change requires full new series.
limits: Fixture-based wiring proves no model capability.
Existing inputs are familiar synthetic controls, not held-out scientific quality evidence.
Four claims exercise nested verdict/citation arrays and index correspondence, not whole research workflow.

independent_review.no_fallback_definition: Zero deterministic-fallback telemetry and no deterministic_lexical result; lexical_founded is permitted for the expected contradiction only when the primary invocation and located quote are retained.
